definitions.explanation: A facility equipped for systematic observation and measurement of natural phenomena such as weather, earthquakes, astronomical bodies, or volcanic activity.

examples.english: There is an observatory on top of the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧{観測所|かんそくじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: They record the temperature at the weather observation station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{天文|てんもん}{観測所|かんそくじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A large telescope is installed at this astronomical observatory.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧ (observation; measurement) and {所|じょ} (place; station). The suffix {所|じょ} is productive in forming names of facilities and offices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧{観測所|かんそくじょ}: weather observation station
- {天文|てんもん}{観測所|かんそくじょ}: astronomical observatory
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧{観測所|かんそくじょ}: seismological observatory
- ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧{観測所|かんそくじょ}: volcano observatory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天文台|てんもんだい}→天文台：09949_tenmondai⟧: astronomical observatory — specifically for astronomy; often a larger, more prominent institution
- ⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧: observation — the act of observing, without the facility
- {測候所|そっこうじょ}: weather station — an older term, largely replaced by ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧{観測所|かんそくじょ}
